plan.summary: BRO-7846: clear TodayTix catalogue art of other productions from 56 closed rows and 3 tours that borrow their banners. 27 rows had their TodayTix poster/thumbnail rejected by the BRO-5089 sweep while the hero from the same catalogue match stayed (follies-2011 kept the 2017 NT Live Follies banner); the rest closed before TodayTix sold tickets (Sept 2013), so TodayTix art on them is another production or another show (grease-2007: an anti-vaping campaign, rain-2010: a Brian Lehrer talk). Every field was looked at by eye. Four thumbnail files on disk predate their TodayTix record and are the right art (follies-2011 2011 cast photo, wonderland-2011, grey-gardens-2006, well-2006): kept, sources recorded as manual in image-sources.json. Sources are added to rejectedImageUrls so the disk fallback and fetcher cannot put them back. No noReliableArt marker: the verified pipeline may refill. (part 1 of 5) (part 5 of 5)
